text:
Iris (Docs): Morning team — quick thread for the release notes we're cutting today. Product wants a short customer blurb, a migration snippet for the embeddings endpoint, and a known-issue about quantized model latency variance. Keep it tight so marketing can reuse.
Priya (PM): Customer line (working): 'Consolidated embeddings endpoint for improved stability — migrate to /api/embeddings using model_id by 2026-05-10.' PM wants the deadline in the sentence.
Sam (SDK): Snippets: Node/Python updated in my PR but Go still needs import path and payload key changes. Also noticed a streaming example that relies on implicit fallback; we should add explicit enable_stream_fallback flag in examples.
Iris (Docs): Good call. Paste exact snippet diffs and I'll swap code blocks.
Sam (SDK): Node old:```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=embed-x', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ input }) })
``` Node new:```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: 'embed-2026-small', input }) })
```
Sam (SDK): Python change: client.embeddings(input='hi', model='embed-x') -> client.embeddings(input='hi', model_id='embed-2026-small')
Sam (SDK): Go change: payload field -> model_id and import -> "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk"
Noah (Eng): Ops note — we added a short-lived redirect from /v1/embeddings -> /api/embeddings in staging; please update canonical links in docs before prod deploy.
Iris (Docs): I'll sweep and replace any /v1/embeddings references. Adding a small 'compatibility shim' section showing a curl header for legacy clients.
Priya (PM): Also include a one-line rollback: if you observe >5% errors after switching, open a support ticket to request temporary aliasing for 48h while you update clients. Keep it direct.
Sam (SDK): Streaming snippet change example: old:```python
resp = client.generate_stream(prompt)
``` new:```python
resp = client.generate_stream(prompt, enable_stream_fallback=True)
```
Iris (Docs): Adding that to the streaming examples and a compatibility note that older runtimes need the flag.
lint-bot: linkcheck: found references to /v1/embeddings in docs/snippets/cli/quickstart.md :warning:
Iris (Docs): Replacing those now.
Sam (SDK): Also spotted Node snippet using old Node import 'const Redwood = require("redwood");' — should use 'const { Redwood } = require("@redwood/inference")'. Will PR that shortly.
Noah (Eng): Small perf callout for the release note: expect ~15% p95 improvement for short-token workloads on our new routing policy. Add as a single bullet.
Priya (PM): Approved. Keep release bullets to three: perf number, embeddings migration + deadline, known issue about quantized memory variance.
Iris (Docs): Drafting the changelog entry and the three bullets now. Will push to branch release/changelog-2026-05 and request quick review.
docs-ci: build started for branch release/changelog-2026-05 (checks: lint, linkcheck, snippet-tests)
Sam (SDK): PR 4422 with import/path fixes + streaming flag landed. Ran snippet-tests locally.
docs-ci: linkcheck passed after fixes; snippet-tests flagged Go example once (old import), fixed in PR 4423.
Iris (Docs): Final merge checklist: 1) replace /v1/embeddings refs (Iris) 2) add streaming flag to examples (Sam) 3) fix Go import and payload (Sam) 4) add rollback/runbook link (Iris) 5) PM sign-off (Priya) 6) docs-ci green.
Priya (PM): Sign-off on copy + rollback wording. :rocket:
docs-ci: build passed on branch release/changelog-2026-05 :white_check_mark:
Iris (Docs): Merging and will ping Marketing with the one-liner and staging URL. If anything weird shows up after deploy, follow /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback. Thanks team! :tada:
